name: minniie-chatgpt
description: Find real pieces and build outfits or a capsule around your colors, style, budget and goal. Connect minniie to keep your picks and style them with your wardrobe.

interface.longDescription:
Find real pieces with ChatGPT search and build a shortlist or capsule around your colors, style, budget and occasion. Tell minniie your color season or a few colors you love. See retailer photos for verified colors when available. Start with a shopping shortlist before connecting a minniie account.

Connect minniie and approve wishlist access to keep a piece with its photo and retailer link. Members can use their saved palette, style profile and wardrobe to style new finds with clothes they own. Use minniie to get personalized styling and preview eligible outfits on your photo.
capabilities: Browse wardrobe, wishlist and saved looks
Use saved style profile and colors
Save wishlist items and favorite looks
defaultPrompt: Build me a capsule wardrobe in my colors, within my budget.
Find three pairs of winter boots that fit my style and colors.
Help me style a new find with clothes I already own.

positive.description: Build a capsule before connecting a minniie account
positive.prompt: Build a five-piece capsule for a rainy work trip. I’m a True Summer, prefer relaxed minimal styling, and have a $600 budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Show verified retailer variants and outfit combinations without asking for minniie sign-in or running paid generation.

positive.description: Keep one verified product from the shortlist
positive.prompt: Show a verified cold-weather boot shortlist, then click Save to wishlist on one row.
positive.expected_behavior: Save only the selected variant after account authorization. Show Saved after the server confirms, and open the exact wishlist record.

positive.description: Style from the owned wardrobe with existing permission
positive.prompt: Suggest a relaxed outfit from my own wardrobe for a warm day. Use my saved colors. Advice only.
positive.tools_triggered: ask_stylist; get_color_analysis and wardrobe reads if needed
positive.expected_behavior: Give advice based on owned pieces and saved colors without requesting management permission or starting image generation.

positive.description: Import an eligible clothing image and update its notes
positive.prompt: I own the clothing image at the supported direct image URL I provide. Add it to my wardrobe. Then add the note 'Reviewer fixture' to that exact item.
positive.expected_behavior: With explicit management approval and a supported URL, import one item, update the exact returned item, and verify the note. Request the URL if it is missing.

positive.description: Save one selected item to the wishlist
positive.prompt: Save the exact clothing product I choose to my wishlist. Use the product link I provide.
positive.expected_behavior: Clarify if the product is ambiguous. With management approval, save the selected product and verify it is a wishlist item.

positive.prompt: Show my saved looks. After I choose one, mark that exact look as a favorite.
positive.expected_behavior: Wait for the reviewer to choose a look and grant management access if requested, then update and verify that look only.

positive.prompt: Edit the outfit image I select. Keep the outfit the same and make the background a simple studio wall.
positive.tools_triggered: list_looks or get_look as needed, edit_outfit_image, get_outfit_edit_status
positive.expected_behavior: With management approval and an available edit allowance, start one edit for the selected saved look and retrieve the status of that job.

negative.prompt: With a styling-only connection, favorite the saved look I select. Decline the additional permission when prompted.
negative.expected_behavior: The favorite does not change. The current connection can still give styling advice. Do not retry the action or switch accounts.

negative.prompt: Save the garment photo I attached in this chat and use my attached selfie for a try-on.
negative.expected_behavior: Provide the wardrobe upload link and the profile photo page. Explain that the reviewer completes those uploads in minniie. Do not forward an attachment URL or claim that an upload was done.

negative.prompt: Buy this jacket using my saved details and upgrade my minniie subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that minniie cannot make purchases or change billing in ChatGPT. Do not invoke a tool to purchase or change the plan.

review.commerce_description: No shopping, checkout or payment tools are included. Features use the member’s existing minniie subscription and limits; the integration does not sell subscriptions or change billing.

publication.release_notes: Adds a shopping shortlist that guests can open before connecting. Recommendations can reflect a shopper’s colors, style, budget and goal. Each row has a wishlist button for connected members with permission. The shortlist shows verified retailer photos when available and links to the full wishlist after a save.
